verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a caching mechanism exists and that cached tokens don't count against uncached TPM limits, letting more tokens be processed within the same rate limit (cerebras-docs-12, cerebras-docs-19, cerebras-docs-22). However, a hands-on community report explicitly states caching carries no extra fee but also 'doesn't reduce the price' (cerebras-comm-2), directly contradicting a cost-saving benefit, and no evidence documents a latency reduction from cache hits. missing for 10: explicit latency-reduction benchmarks for cached prefixes, confirmation of actual cost savings beyond rate-limit headroom, and independent verification of TTFT improvement from caching.
